source: Drone 1 with the rubber bands off (2026-11-15 from 06:29 UTC): airframe_2026-11-12_raised.json with its pitch path refitted by sw/sim/identify_airframe.py on that night's INDI-free hovers (06-29-06, 06-32-31, 06-47-14, 06-48-18, 06-49-27; 4 flights, 65 s airborne; --folds 0), every other term frozen. What moved: servo_delay 0.043 -> 0.055 s (right 0.040 -> 0.048), servo_inertia 0.00022 -> 0.00121 (the assemblies' swing on the body, about 5x), servo_compliance 0.0047 -> 0.040, link_c 0.046 -> 0.097, wash 0.70 -> 0.55, wake_tau 0.77 -> 0.57, drag_z_x 0.13 -> 0.21; the bands' preload left_band 0.072 -> 0.050. Checked against the 06-50-46 pitch doublet (not fitted): from the logged state on the logged references it swings -40/+36 degrees against the real -43/+30 (the raised model -30/+28), and pitch_damping 9 with pitch_damping_tau 0.03 never settles on it, as the 06-53 hops diverged at about 2.3 Hz; sw/sim/models/NOTES.md 'Pitch loop without the bands'.
